basic_info.description: Welcome to 1598 Bay Street, a residential icon in a prime Marina location, constructed in 2018 of concrete and steel for high structural and acoustic integrity. Residence 104 includes a beautiful palette of finishes and materials, highlighted by culinary-level appliances, lavish amounts of quartz and marble, meticulous finishes, light-filled living spaces, and a private enclosed patio (with ring security camera). In-unit washer/dryer. Heat and A/C. Automated window shades. Walk-in finished closet. 1-car garage parking and large storage. Building roof deck includes BBQ and lounge area, fire pit area with Bay and GG Bridge views. Secured entry with Butterfly MX intercom system. Package storage, Bicycle storage and repair station. Close to Fort Mason, Moscone Park, Marina Green. On a flat block close to shopping. Not on liquefaction.
